name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Onyx Dog

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This onyx statuette of a dog can become a Mastiff for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has Intelligence 8, speaks Common, and has Blindsight with a range of 60 feet. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
